title.en: Video Per-Call Task Channels and H3 Variants Available
title.zh: 视频按次生成任务通道与 H3 衍生变体模型上线

summary.en: Per-call fixed billing task models `seedance-2-0-task`, `seedance-2-5-task`, `minimax-h3-task`, along with variants `minimax-h3-turbo` and `minimax-h3-video`, are now live on OmniMux.
summary.zh: 按次计费视频任务模型 `seedance-2-0-task`、`seedance-2-5-task`、`minimax-h3-task` 及 H3 系列变体 `minimax-h3-turbo`、`minimax-h3-video` 现已接入 OmniMux 提供异步调用。

body.en:
## Video Task and Variant Models

OmniMux now supports dedicated per-call video task channels and H3 model variants under the standard video endpoint.

### Model specification

- **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Polling endpoint:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **Per-call models:** `seedance-2-0-task`, `seedance-2-5-task`, `minimax-h3-task` (billed per task call)
- **H3 variants:** `minimax-h3-turbo` (turbo rendering), `minimax-h3-video` (dedicated video pipeline)

### Request example

```json
{
  "model": "seedance-2-0-task",
  "prompt": "A cinematic drone shot of coastal mountains at sunset",
  "seconds": 5
}
```

Full parameter definitions are documented in the [Seedance 2.0 Reference](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/seedance-2-0) and [MiniMax H3 Reference](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3).
body.zh:
## 视频按次任务通道与变体模型

OmniMux 标准视频端点现已支持按次任务计费模型与 H3 系列衍生变体。

### 接口规范

- **创建端点：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **轮询端点：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **按次计费模型：** `seedance-2-0-task`、`seedance-2-5-task`、`minimax-h3-task`（固定单次扣费）
- **H3 衍生变体：** `minimax-h3-turbo`（极速出片）、`minimax-h3-video`（高画质专线）

### 请求示例

```json
{
  "model": "seedance-2-0-task",
  "prompt": "海边山脉日落航拍全景镜头",
  "seconds": 5
}
```

完整参数定义请参阅 [Seedance 2.0 接口文档](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/seedance-2-0) 与 [MiniMax H3 接口文档](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3)。
